DRYAD.direct_download: _links.stash:download.href must be present and use HTTPS
DRYAD.ordering: provider default ordering as captured; no retry-dependent extension
DRYAD.structured_publication_relation: relatedWorks[].relationship == primary_article with a DOI identifier

FIGSHARE.direct_download: download_disabled != true and at least one files[].download_url HTTPS entry
mirror_exclusions: resource hosted by another counted provider when Figshare is only a metadata mirror
FIGSHARE.query_cross_product: all frozen domain queries x item_type
FIGSHARE.structured_publication_relation: resource_doi DOI, or related_materials DOI with relation IsSupplementTo/IsDerivedFrom/References, distinct from the object DOI

HARVARD_DATAVERSE.citation_only_rule: citation or title without structured publication DOI is CANNOT_CHECK_PAIR_IDENTITY
HARVARD_DATAVERSE.direct_download: at least one latestVersion.files[].dataFile persistentId or id with restricted == false and storageIdentifier present
HARVARD_DATAVERSE.structured_publication_relation: citation/publication metadata contains publicationIDType DOI and publicationIDNumber DOI in a provider-defined publication field

boundary: item metadata rights only; linked publication rights and natural-pair eligibility remain unadjudicated
cannot_check_rule: unmapped, missing, generic GPL, host-only, collection-only or linked-object-only rights are not accepted
